row.proto: void Game_PracticeProgrammeSystem_BindCompareLap(void *system, uint8_t car, uint8_t old_car, void *lap, uint32_t arg5)
row.notes: Practice programme system method (rcx system: +0x280 lap times, +0x290, +0x298 car list +0x28..+0x30, +0x2a8; dl car, 0xff returns; r8b the previous car; r9 a telemetry lap). Binds the telemetry lap to the car (lap+0x130 and +0xd0 = the car's +0x58 object, +0xc4 = 0x3f, +0xc8 from its +0xe0 component) and calls each listener in lap+0x170..+0x178 (vcall +8 with lap+0xc0), calls 0x1434bc540([system+0x290], car, 1), then copies bit 0 (not clean) of the lap's summary flags +0x2c0 (0x14294127b) into the car's current lap record: set makes it invalid (+0xd8 = ((+0xe0 & 1) == 0), 0x14294131b), clear makes it valid (+0xd8 = +0xe0 & 1, 0x1429412be), and reports either through Sess_LapTimes_ReportLapInvalidation_Thunk at 0x142941328 (valid 0 or 1). It then posts a message (vtable 0x1457b7470, payload car << 32 | the 5th argument) and, when the previous car is another valid car, releases it (0x142f1be60 with 0x28, 0x142a3f330 on [system+0x2a8]). Callers Game_PracticeProgrammeSystem_OnCompareVehicleChanged at 0x142940958 (telemetry lap slot 4, 5th argument 1) and Game_PracticeProgrammeSystem_OnCompareVehicleChanged_2 at 0x142940d6f, and the .data1 body at 0x14d598be3. Steam 1.0.145 0x1429434b0 and EA 1.0.145 0x14293c830 (restored dump): 203 of 203 instructions the same, +0x2c0/+0xd8/+0xe0/+0x9c80/+0x280 used at the same places.
